descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
The simulation technology that powers workforce training in the world’s leading industries, now in a personal use version for individuals!
Step into a fully immersive HVAC training environment with Skillveri HVAC Simulator - Personal Use edition.

Forget watching videos - start doing. Using Skillveri’s advanced hand-tracking technology, you can perform all actions naturally with your hands, just as you would in the field - no controllers needed!

The realistic VR simulation for aspiring HVAC techs, this Personal version offers you hands-on practice anytime, anywhere.

Immerse yourself in a realistic scenario and navigate complex tasks with ease using visual cues and step by step instructions.

This Personal version contains:
- Commercial HVAC Cleaning and Maintenance
- Residential HVAC Leak Testing

Ready to scale your training or adopt it for your institution? For our fully-loaded Enterprise version, perfect for schools and training institutions, contact us at usa@skillveri.com. Skillveri simulators are used across 100+ schools and colleges across the USA in their CTE programs.
